import { Route, Switch } from "wouter";
import { CustomerDetailContainer } from "../../features/customer/containers/customer-detail-container";
import { CustomerFormContainer } from "../../features/customer/containers/customer-form-container";
import { CustomerListContainer } from "../../features/customer/containers/customer-list-container";
import { HomePage } from "../../pages/home";
import { NotFoundPage } from "../../pages/not-found";
import type { NavEntry } from "../../shared/ui/layout";
import { customRoutes } from "../routes";

export const navEntries: NavEntry[] = [{ label: "Customers", href: "/customers" }];

export function AppRoutes() {
  return (
    <Switch>
      <Route path="/">
        <HomePage entries={navEntries} />
      </Route>
      {customRoutes}
      <Route path="/customers">
        <CustomerListContainer />
      </Route>
      <Route path="/customers/new">
        <CustomerFormContainer />
      </Route>
      <Route path="/customers/:id/edit">
        {(params) => <CustomerFormContainer id={params.id} />}
      </Route>
      <Route path="/customers/:id">{(params) => <CustomerDetailContainer id={params.id} />}</Route>
      <Route>
        <NotFoundPage />
      </Route>
    </Switch>
  );
}
